During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''''Munificent''-class star frigate''' was commanded by a [[Unidentified Neimoidian captain|Neimoidian captain]], who led it to a [[Battle of Florrum|battle]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].
